assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease.
The symptoms are episodic in nature.
There is a need to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances.
A cardiac event monitor is ordered to capture arrhythmic activity during symptomatic periods.
The study will assist in confirming the diagnosis of atrial fibrillation.
The study will guide appropriate rate or rhythm control management.
The CPT code for the cardiac event monitor is 93271.
The diagnosis codes are I48.0, I25.10, and I48.91.
The reason code for the denial is PR-204.
